shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -120'
/bin/bash -lc "cat app/layout.tsx && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/ProductGrid.tsx && cat app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && cat 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && cat app/globals.css"

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version\" && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && rg -n \"ViewTransition|transitionTypes\" node_modules/react node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/link.js"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import * as React from 'react'; console.log('ViewTransition' in React, React.version)\" && ls -1 | head -50 && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@types/react/package.json"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' lib/products.ts && sed -n '1,100p' package-lock.json && rg -n '\"react\"|\"react-dom\"|\"@types/react\"' package-lock.json | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/next/package.json | rg -n 'peerDependencies|react|version' -C 2 && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/react/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,2))\" && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/react-dom/package.json'); console.log(p.version, JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,2))\""
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view react@canary version && npm view react-dom@canary version && npm view react@19.3.0 version'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css package.json package-lock.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import * as React from 'react'; console.log({version: React.version, hasViewTransition: 'ViewTransition' in React})\" && node -p \"require('./node_modules/react-dom/package.json').version\" && git status --short"
